Q01.sql:
WITH closure_calls AS (
  SELECT
    site_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT conversation_id) AS closure_call_count
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.fct_calls`
  WHERE is_account_closure_call
    AND conversation_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY site_id
),
site_costs AS (
  SELECT
    site_id,
    SUM(total_expense) AS total_expense_last_year
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.fct_cc_site_cost_monthly`
  WHERE month_start BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY site_id
)
SELECT
  d.site_id,
  d.site_name,
  d.operator,
  d.is_outsourced,
  c.closure_call_count,
  s.total_expense_last_year
FROM closure_calls c
JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.dim_cc_site` d ON c.site_id = d.site_id
LEFT JOIN site_costs s ON d.site_id = s.site_id
ORDER BY c.closure_call_count DESC

Q02.sql:
WITH latest_scores AS (
  SELECT customer_key, churn_probability, risk_band
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.ml_scores.churn_score_v3`
  WHERE score_date = (SELECT MAX(score_date) FROM `fennmoor-dw.ml_scores.churn_score_v3`)
),
high_balance_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_key, total_deposit_balance
  FROM `fennmoor-analytics.looker_scratch.LR_6H0IZB3PQ4C6N_customer_facts`
  WHERE total_deposit_balance >= 100000
)

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT h.customer_key) AS high_balance_customers,
  AVG(s.churn_probability) AS avg_churn_probability,
  COUNTIF(s.risk_band = 'HIGH') AS high_risk_customers,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(s.risk_band = 'HIGH'), COUNT(DISTINCT h.customer_key)) AS high_risk_share
FROM high_balance_customers h
JOIN latest_scores s
  ON h.customer_key = s.customer_key

Q09.why: no column holds delinquency_rate (2 of 3 match)
Q09.sql:
WITH OPEN_LOANS AS (
  SELECT
    PRODUCT_CODE,
    BRANCH_ID,
    COUNT(*) AS N
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_account`
  WHERE ACCOUNT_FAMILY = 'LOAN'
    AND IS_OPEN
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
DLQ AS (
  SELECT
    A.PRODUCT_CODE,
    A.BRANCH_ID,
    COUNT(*) AS D
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_risk.fct_delinquency_daily` DD
  JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_account` A USING (ACCOUNT_KEY)
  WHERE DD.SNAPSHOT_DATE = (SELECT MAX(SNAPSHOT_DATE) FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_risk.fct_delinquency_daily`)
    AND DD.DPD >= 30
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  O.PRODUCT_CODE,
  B.BRANCH_NAME,
  O.N AS OPEN_LOANS,
  COALESCE(DLQ.D, 0) AS DELINQUENT_LOANS,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(DLQ.D, 0), O.N) AS DELINQUENCY_RATE
FROM OPEN_LOANS O
LEFT JOIN DLQ USING (PRODUCT_CODE, BRANCH_ID)
LEFT JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_branch` B ON B.BRANCH_ID = O.BRANCH_ID
ORDER BY DELINQUENCY_RATE DESC

L5bac0ee7.why: no column holds DLQ, RATE (3 of 5 match)
L5bac0ee7.sql:
WITH open_loans AS (
  SELECT
    account_key,
    product_code,
    branch_id
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_account`
  WHERE account_family = 'LOAN'
    AND is_open = TRUE
),
delinquency AS (
  SELECT
    account_key,
    dpd
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_risk.fct_delinquency_daily`
  WHERE snapshot_date = '2026-04-05'
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    o.branch_id,
    p.product_name,
    o.account_key,
    d.dpd
  FROM open_loans o
  JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_product` p
    ON o.product_code = p.product_code
  LEFT JOIN delinquency d
    ON o.account_key = d.account_key
)
SELECT
  product_name,
  branch_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT account_key) AS open_loan_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dpd >= 30 THEN account_key END) AS delinquent_30plus_count,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dpd >= 30 THEN account_key END),
    COUNT(DISTINCT account_key)
  ) AS delinquency_rate
FROM joined
GROUP BY product_name, branch_id
ORDER BY delinquency_rate DESC;
